Spain's AEPD disclosed the first notified breach where an AI agent chained multiple attack stages autonomously. It moves beyond AI-assisted phishing to agent-driven execution across the kill chain, with major implications for detection and breach reporting. #AgenticAI #DataBreach #IncidentResponse
